# Windows platform selection

The two Cargo manifests in this directory select the Windows backends of `gpui-fast-platform` 0.1.17 and `gpui-pre-platform` 0.3.12. The product uses both through gpui-kit. Cargo resolves optional Linux desktop notification dependencies into the portable upstream lock graph even for a Windows-only distribution.

[windows.rs](windows.rs) contains the shared Windows entry points. The manifests retain the portable feature names accepted by gpui-kit and forward Windows renderer and testing features to the corresponding Windows crate. The desktop uses [gpui-pre-windows 0.3.12](../gpui-pre-windows/Cargo.toml) with a local extension for a fixed logical viewport width. The restored main window uses the same scale for text rendering, pointer coordinates and accessibility bounds. When upgrading GPUI, check the layout-width and resize handlers in [events.rs](../gpui-pre-windows/src/events.rs) and the [native window test](../../apps/patina/tests/pages/window_scale.rs). Independent repository tools build on Linux without linking a desktop platform.
